svg.aria-label: What I work with. Android: AOSP and custom ROMs, device trees, vendor blobs, SELinux sepolicy, Treble and GSI. Kernel: Linux 3.4 and 4.9 for Qualcomm, defconfigs, CPU and GPU governors, linux-stable and CAF merges, AnyKernel3 flashers, build scripts. Languages: C, C++, Go, Kotlin, TypeScript, Shell. Systems: Linux server, Docker, nginx reverse proxy and Let's Encrypt, WireGuard and Tailscale, Cloudflare DNS, backups with rclone. Tooling: git and repo, GitHub Actions and GHCR, Vitest, MCP, specs and plans before code.
